mission_phase: Generation 20 - Sites as First-Class + History Hygiene
phase_goal: Make identified Shopify sites a persistent, always-visible list that survives run cleanup and can be re-inspected, and stop deleted runs from appearing as phantom entries by keeping the inspection-history index consistent with runs on disk.
reason_generation_started: Operator cleaned all inspection runs but (1) wants the list of already-identified Shopify sites to persist and be visible, and (2) still sees deleted runs in the left panel because cleanup removed run directories without pruning the inspection-history index.

functional: The inspection list never shows a run whose directory no longer exists.
Cleanup prunes inspection-history rows for removed runs so the index matches disk.
A Sites list is derived from target manifests that have an evaluation, persists through run cleanup, and each site can be inspected (enqueues a run).
usability: Holistic as-a-user walkthrough: after cleaning all runs, identified sites remain visible and inspectable; no phantom runs appear; selecting a site behaves sensibly.
technical: validate:dashboard extended with sites API + phantom-filter assertions; all suites green; git diff --check clean.

validation_notes: VAL-068 two clean passes: sites API + persistent list, phantom-run filtering + history pruning, all suites green; second pass with no implementation changes after the commit.

Holistic UI walkthrough (new gate): after cleaning all runs, 8 identified sites remain visible and inspectable; the Runs section sits below with no phantom entries; selecting a run updates the right pane.
BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-009 (52 BDDs, 2 new for GEN-020, 50 passing, 2 deferred).
known_gaps_opened: The dashboard validator hard-depends on a Ridge GEN-013 run existing; cleaning all runs breaks it until one is restored (validator robustness, logged not fixed).
Site cards show only the latest run status; per-site run history is still browsed via the Runs list, not grouped under the site.
